i'm sarah ♡

I spend a lot of my time trying new things, navigating my 20s, and figuring out what actually matters.

Right now, I'm a product manager in Silicon Valley. But I grew up in Hong Kong, where life was super fast paced so these days, I'm learning how to slow down, live more intentionally, and make time for the things that bring me joy.

01 / the first little project

i made something sparkly.

It's called Bedazzel, a little virtual face-gem studio inspired by the Kylie Gems trend!

I've always wanted to try those cute face stickers, but the thought of buying them just to use them once felt a little wasteful. So I thought, why not just make my own digital version?

pick a gem. decorate your face. have fun.

You can choose from different rhinestones, place them on your face with your mouse or a pinch gesture, and save your look when you're done.

It's a pretty simple idea, but making it reminded me how much I enjoy creating things just for the fun of it.

here's how to try it ↓
02 / two ways to play
01

try Bedazzel yourself

Download the game and open it on your laptop. Allow your webcam, then start decorating!

laptop recommended · private, on-device camera
02

make your own version

I started with a simple prompt and just kept experimenting. There was a lot of trial and error, and honestly, way more tweaking than I expected before I finally got something I liked.

But that's also what made it fun! I've shared my prompt below so just copy it into your favorite AI tool, change whatever you like, keep iterating and see what you come up with!

bedazzel-prompt.txt






all 28 gems · transparent
Download the 28 individual transparent PNGs, then upload them to your AI alongside the prompt above.









✧ a quick note on opening the game


For the best experience, play on a laptop. Bedazzel’s interface works best on a larger screen.


  1. Download bedazzle.html to your laptop.
  2. Open the file in Chrome or Safari. Press start and allow your camera. If camera access doesn't work for a downloaded file, open it from a localhost or HTTPS site instead.


Opening this from Instagram? Its built-in browser may prevent downloads or camera access. Open this page in your regular Chrome or Safari browser first. 








03 / a little more about me






so, who is sarah?


Thank you for stopping by my little corner of the internet.


I'm currently figuring out who I want to become, and building a life that feels meaningful to me. Outside of work, I love trying new things and saying yes to new experiences that pushes me outside my comfort zone.


One of my dreams is to inspire more people to create. So this space is where I document that journey, share what I'm learning along the way, and hopefully encourage you to start something of your own.


If you've created something you're proud of, I'd love to see it.Feel free to reach out and come say hi on Instagram.
